description: This file defines the 'InProcessSiloHandle' class in the Orleans.TestingHost namespace, which manages an in-process silo deployment including creation, stopping, and disposal methods, and properties for accessing silo details.

classes.name: InProcessSiloHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle for a silo deployed within the same process, providing lifecycle management and access to silo details.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and starts a new in-process silo handle with specified configuration.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo asynchronously, with an option for graceful or immediate shutdown.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync (overload with CancellationToken)
methods.description: Stops the silo asynchronously, respecting the provided cancellation token.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the silo handle, stopping the silo if active.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes the silo handle, stopping the silo if active.
